pages.title: Lakeshore Retail pilot – delivery commitments
pages.author: emil
pages.body:
Record of what Zava has committed to Lakeshore Retail for the Aurora pilot. Owner: Emil Vanggaard (Product). Change this page only with Product and Platform agreement.

## Key dates

| Date | Milestone | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Friday, November 20 | Pilot stores cut over from the legacy polling status service to the event-driven status service | Tama Surya (Platform) |
| Monday, November 23 | Pilot expansion: every Lakeshore Retail pilot store goes live on Aurora | Emil Vanggaard (Product) |

## What must be true for November 23

- Device status is served by the event-driven status service for all pilot stores. The legacy polling path is not used for the pilot after November 20.
- Reconnected hubs show Online in the store dashboard within one heartbeat interval. Tracked in AUR-142.
- Automated reconnect tests run against the event-driven status service, not only the legacy path.
- Rollout regression checks pass on the event-driven status service. Tracked in AUR-139.

## Sign-off

- **Platform sign-off is required for any change to reconnect or status-state handling on the event-driven status service.** Platform approver: Tama Surya. Approval is recorded on the matching ADR in this space.
- Product sign-off for the expansion: Emil Vanggaard.

## Customer communication

No release date for the reconnect fix has been shared with Lakeshore Retail. Product sends any date only after Platform sign-off.

## Change log

| Date | Change |
|---|---|
| October 23 | Added the reconnect requirement after the Lakeshore Retail report of hubs staying Offline after reconnect. |
| October 14 | Confirmed November 20 cutover and November 23 expansion. |

pages.title: ADR-014: Reconnect state handling on the event-driven status service
pages.author: triin
pages.body:
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | **Proposed – awaiting platform approval** |
| Decision owner | Tama Surya (Platform Lead) |
| Author | Triin Lepp |
| Related | AUR-142, GitHub zava-lab/aurora-status PR #287 |
| Needed by | Before the event-driven reconnect fix can be built and tested ahead of the November 20 cutover |

## Context

After a network reconnect, Aurora hubs can stay Offline in the store dashboard even though telemetry has resumed (AUR-142). PR #287 fixes this on the legacy polling path only. The Lakeshore Retail pilot stores move to the event-driven status service on November 20, so the same correction is needed there. On the event-driven service, a reconnect can arrive before or after the first heartbeat, so the order of events decides which state wins.

## Options

| Option | How it works | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|
| A. Clear Offline on reconnect event | Status consumer sets Online when it receives a device reconnect event | Simple, but a late Offline event can flip the hub back to Offline |
| B. Reconcile on first heartbeat | Status consumer keeps a per-device session version and sets Online on the first heartbeat after a reconnect, ignoring older events | Needs a schema change to the device state table and new reconnect tests |

## Proposal

Option B. It handles out-of-order events, which the event-driven service produces during store network restarts.

## What happens after approval

1. Triin implements Option B in the event-driven status consumer on PR #287.
2. Maria adds reconnect tests against the event-driven status service.
3. Platform re-reviews PR #287.

## Decision

Pending. Approval needed from Tama Surya. Option B touches status-state handling on the event-driven status service, so platform sign-off is required (see Lakeshore Retail pilot – delivery commitments).

Sprint 24 runs Monday, October 26 to Friday, November 20.

## Sprint goal

- Cutover dry run on Wednesday, November 18.

pages.title: Status-service cutover runbook (November 20)
pages.author: kerry
pages.body:
Draft. Tracked in AUR-136.

## Switch order

1. Freeze status-service deploys at 12:00 on November 20.
2. Move the pilot store group to the event-driven status service.
3. Watch dashboard Online and Offline counts for 30 minutes.

## Rollback

If Online counts drop by more than 5% for 10 minutes, move the pilot store group back to the legacy polling path. Owner on call: Maria Oliva.

## Open items

- Final switch order to be confirmed at the November 18 dry run.
